shulkerboxtooltip.config.option.controls: Hold this key when previewing a stack to lock the tooltip.
In compact mode, how should items with the same ID
but different component data be compacted?
Ignored:
 Ignores component data
First Item:
 Items are displayed as all having
 the same component as the first item
Separate:
 Separates items with different component data

How compact preview items should be ordered.
Stack Size: sort stacks by size, largest first.
Preview Order: preserve the order of items as they appear in the container preview.

If on, items with the container data component
that are not explicitly supported will still show a preview,
as if they were a shulker box.

The theme to use for bundle preview windows.
Vanilla:
 Vanilla's default look and feel.
ShulkerBoxTooltip:
 ShulkerBoxTooltip's custom look and feel.
